payload.detail: The 14 Oct admin source pilot proof (docs/design-system/evidence/admin-source-pilot.json) ran against an earlier pilot-client digest, and its harness is not in the repo. Native labels, keyboard order and the polite announcement are now pinned against the current client by tests/admin-pilot-client-accessibility.dom.test.tsx on every change (branch claude/ingestion-review-lbw6rf, 16 Oct). Still not done: a real screen-reader run (VoiceOver or NVDA) by a person, and the dark, forced-colours, 320px and print checks against the current digest. Low value while the page is administrator-only.
